reviewer_statement: Developer-scoped six-domain scientific artist review only. Three-platform R and pinned Python 1.2 Matplotlib regression tests have been authored but exact-head success is not observed. Full Python runtime, error-class and Matplotlib Axes parity and independent certification are not asserted.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R numeric inference and default plotting untouched. strict_source_record returns inspectable frozen Python scientific plotting geometry in a typed R record, without backend identity.

case_evidence.description: Frozen eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0 public plotting signature compared with explicit opt-in strict source artist record; no injected Python Matplotlib ax.

Actual native already-calibrated FPCR familywise or Monte Carlo diagnostic records, finite source arrays and correct target IDs; positive max_targets, boolean show_targetwise and strict flag. Language-specific Python object protocols remain outside scope.

Source maxT errorbar marker o and optional target-wise marker x use original probability centers, asymmetric exact-binomial limits, capsize 3 and fixed-target ordering; one horizontal alpha line with source limits -0.02 to 1.02, labels and legend. Genuine native postcalibration objects drive the tests; fixed Python 1.2 public Matplotlib errorbar segment and artist comparisons are authored, pending CI execution.
Invalid max targets, type flags, probability values, interval order and unsupported records are explicitly rejected using R error conditions. Python exception class identity remains outside scope.

Existing invisible native base-R numerical frame is preserved by default; strict mode returns typed R scientific artist record with x/y/errorbars, labels, reference and Matplotlib return-kind metadata. No live Python Axes, figure or raster equivalence.

Exact Clopper-Pearson binomial Monte Carlo intervals for fixed-design wild-bootstrap exceedance frequencies. Plotted intervals quantify finite simulation precision and do not imply effect uncertainty or improve familywise rejection control.

independent_review_status: Provisional developer scientific geometry review, exact-head CI unobserved, zero independent certifications.
language_specific_limits: No Python Matplotlib Axes/Figure object identity or Python-specific exception class equivalence.
Native R list validation differs from frozen Python dataclass-instance and optional injected ax runtime protocols.
Bootstrap procedure, sampling law, fixed-family coverage and inferential estimands are not modified.
